integrity: The proof independently normalizes the coordinate and cover hyperplanes, constructs a feasible center from longest cover-chain levels, and matches it with a sharp telescoping upper bound along a source-rank longest chain. Finite reconstruction of generalized snake posets is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for the standard Euclidean realization of generalized snake order polytopes. It gives one incenter but does not classify all incenters, and it does not determine circumradii or affine-invariant metric data. A residual originality risk remains for a general order-polytope Chebyshev-center observation under different terminology.
title: Rank alone determines the Euclidean inradius of generalized snake order polytopes
